pages.title: Something At The Top
pages.text: The idol waiting at the top of the Hunger's tower isn't just for atmosphere. Speak with it - right-click - and, if you come bearing the right things, it will trade.

pages.title: The First Price
pages.text: Offer it 3 Tokens of the Hunger, and it accepts them without a word. That's only the opening price, though - come back empty-handed and nothing more happens yet.

pages.title: The Second Price
pages.text: Return later with 1 Arcane Ink, and the trade completes: something passes back the other way. The Hunger's Pact, once granted, is yours to keep - it isn't consumed, and right-clicking it opens onto something new.
